_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. Tracked inventory of every dependency this project knowingly accepts. Read by tools/Test-DependencyInventory.ps1 and tools/test-dependency-inventory.sh (issue #164, docs/adr-phase-9.md ADR-0043). A new entry here is itself a review checkpoint: confirm the license is MIT-compatible and, for nativeDependencies, that the exact port version has been checked against the GitHub Advisory Database (see the cpp-msbuild skill, section 5) before adding it.
_nativeDependencies_comment: vcpkg ports. Empty because the project has zero third-party C++ dependencies (docs/adr.md ADR-0005/ADR-0007). No scanner understands vcpkg.json today (docs/adr-phase-9.md ADR-0043), so advisory review for anything added here is manual: record port, version, license, justification, and the ISO date the advisory check was performed.

githubActions.justification: Checks out the repository; used by every workflow.
Puts msbuild.exe on PATH for the hosted windows-latest runner.
Runs the owner-only commit-author gate via the GitHub API.
Stages release binaries between the build and publish jobs.
Retrieves staged release binaries in the publish job.
Publishes the draft GitHub release with the built assets.
Runs MSVC static analysis and emits SARIF for Code Scanning upload.
Uploads SARIF results from MSVC code analysis to GitHub Code Scanning.

_githubActions_comment: Allow-listed action REPOSITORIES only, deliberately without pinned SHAs here -- tools/Test-DependencyInventory.ps1 checks the SHA pin separately by reading each workflow file, so Dependabot's routine SHA bumps never require touching this file. Adding a new repo here is the actual review checkpoint; keeping it in step with the workflow's SHA is Dependabot's job.

agentToolingDependencies.justification: Dev-time agent skill bundle deployed by apm; not shipped in the built executable.

_agentToolingDependencies_comment: Recorded so the tripwire's apm.lock.yaml hit is an acknowledged fact, not an unexplained pass. Not part of the shipped product.
_acknowledgedPaths_comment: Escape hatch for a tripwire pattern that is legitimately present for a reason other than a new dependency. Empty today; add an entry with a path and a reason before suppressing a finding here.
